material_definitions: The study investigates three series of LISICON-type solid solutions: Li3P(1-x)VxO4, Li(3+x)V(1-x)GexO4, and Li(3+x)P(1-x)GexO4 (x = 0 to 1).
Samples without partial lithium occupancy (Li3P(1-x)VxO4 and Li4GeO4) were measured in the temperature range 90 °C to 150 °C.
Compounds with partial lithium occupancy (Li(3+x)V(1-x)GexO4 and Li(3+x)P(1-x)GexO4, x = 0.2-0.8) were measured between -30 °C and 150 °C.
Aliovalent substitution of P5+ or V5+ for Ge4+ creates partial lithium occupancy, resulting in much higher conductivities and lower activation energies.
The study investigates three series of LISICON-type solid solutions: Li3P(1-x)VxO4, Li(3+x)V(1-x)GexO4, and Li(3+x)P(1-x)GexO4 (x = 0 to 1).

Aliovalent substitution of P5+ or V5+ for Ge4+ creates partial lithium occupancy, resulting in much higher conductivities and lower activation energies.
